item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 02/Apr/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a southerly airstream, the weather will be hot and brighter over the coastal areas of southern China in the next couple of days. A trough of low pressure is expected to bring showers and thunderstorms to southern China over the weekend. The northeast monsoon will affect the coastal areas of Guangdong early to midweek next week.
